facts.activity_file: charging, tying in and guarding a blast

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: audit finding - assurance activity of material unwanted event control at ZV-7210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EXPLOSIVES_RECONCILIATION: the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives on ZV-7210 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in charging and firing, specifically charging, tying in and guarding a blast. ZV-7210 (emergency shutdown valves) is in service for jetty and manifold emergency isolation. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 17 December 2025 a planned assurance activity of ZV-7210 at Cape Verity Export Terminal found the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives not effective.
